body:
d1-2B is a decision model for text, pictures, and video, built on LFM3-VL-2B. It returns calibrated answers in one forward pass, without generating tokens.

## Ficha rápida

- LiquidAI/d1-2B
- 1.9B parámetros
- VRAM mínima estimada 1.6 GB (Portátil / GPU 4 GB)
- ~400 tok/s en RTX 4090 (Q4)
- licencia other
- 134 likes en Hugging Face

## Descripción original

d1-2B is a decision model for text, pictures, and video, built on LFM3-VL-2B. It returns calibrated answers in one forward pass, without generating tokens.

- Best-in-class: it leads the open d1 models on average and on our board of over a hundred decision benchmarks, ahead of d1-3B at under two thirds of its size. - Beyond classification: it also extracts text, numbers, and dates with their span, locates objects in pictures, and estimates quantities with an interval. - Millisecond decisions: 5.7 ms per decision on an NVIDIA H100 and 3.8 ms on an AMD MI325X, with any number of questions about one state in one call.

Find more information about open d1 in our release blog post.

The LFM3 family includes base, text, vision, audio, omni, and decision models. d1-2B decides over text, pictures, and video, and d1-Omni-2B adds audio.
